title: A DEAD WARDEN LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: Warden wreck drops a box, it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Warden left the generic purple cache box. The cache is now tagged a Warden wreck and drawn as the Warden in pieces in its own palette: a slipped track, a slumped chassis, the toppled torso with a dead visor, the cannon on the ground, the torn off pod, smoke while unsearched. The Overseer wreck is the black and brass version, bigger. Looting is unchanged, and this adds the table the other machine wrecks plug into.
now: A dead Warden leaves a smoking wreck, not a box.
